response.justification: Bogdan is an accomplished full-stack/web engineer with 15+ years of experience and genuine low-latency systems work (D-language microservices at Sociomantic, C/C++ at National Instruments), but the role requires deep hardware-domain expertise that is entirely absent from the resume. There is no evidence of SoC/IP modeling, RTL or architectural simulation, SIMD/MIMD or GPU architecture work, deep-learning training/inference optimization, or hardware-software co-design. The educational path (BS + 8 years) is satisfied on paper, but the technical experience is in a different discipline. AI exposure is limited to agent tooling and MCP code generation, not accelerator workloads. This is a fundamental domain mismatch rather than a seniority gap.
strengths: 15+ years of engineering experience; meets BS + 8 years bar
Proven low-latency, high-throughput systems work in D and C/C++
Strong open-source, teaching, and technical-communication track record
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, hardware architecture, or co-design experience
No deep neural network training/inference or GPU workload optimization
Career focus is web/full-stack, not silicon performance architecture

key_factors.factor: No AI accelerator or DNN optimization background
